messages.subject: ordinal endogenous variable in sem
parts:
HI, 

I tried to fit a model using sem that includes an ordinal endogenous variable of 4 levels (0-3). I got error like this:

"Error in if (all(lik > 0)) logl <- sum(log(lik)) else logl <- -Inf : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In atanh(rho.init) : NaNs produced"


Anybody knows what it means?
Thank you!

Xu Zhang
